headline: Going Commando adds matches across releases and repairs fresh compiler builds
summary: Matching work landed for Going Commando's USA v1.01, PAL and USA v2.00 releases, including the latter's Grelbin status HUD. A matched function compiles to exactly the same bytes as the original game. The project's recorded progress figure for USA v1.01 remains 98.83% of code, unchanged from the previous day.
highlights: A shorter README and organised documentation replace the long setup guide and hand-maintained progress tables (#440).
A follow-up repairs fresh compiler builds after the documentation move changed a comment in the patched compiler source without updating its expected checksum.
Open #441 and #442 propose more PAL and USA v2.00 C ports, with near misses kept separately. #441 also marks three functions as original assembly. Neither pull request has merged.
